topics.label: Introduction and the Hallmarks of Cancer Framework
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic opens the lecture by setting out the learning outcomes, progression models of tumorigenesis, and the conceptual framework of cancer hallmarks.

topics.label: Growth Signal Independence and Proliferative Signaling Cascades
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how mutations in cell surface receptors and intracellular signaling cascades constitutively activate cell proliferation and survival pathways.

topics.label: Differentiation Block in Leukemias and Carcinomas
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how defects in terminal differentiation prevent mature cell cycle withdrawal and maintain proliferative precursor states in tissue.

topics.label: Evasion of Apoptosis, Telomere Maintenance, and Senescence Bypass
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how cancer cells evade programmed cell death and bypass replicative senescence through telomerase reactivation and disruption of p53 stress signaling.

topics.label: Cancer Metabolism and Epigenetic Reprogramming
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how tumors rewire metabolic pathways through aerobic glycolysis and Krebs cycle mutations that produce onco-metabolites and alter the epigenome.

topics.label: Tumor Angiogenesis and the Angiogenic Switch
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the necessity of blood vessel recruitment for tumor perfusion, its timing during lesion development, and its regulatory balance.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Dissemination Routes of Cancer Metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic addresses the multistep invasion-metastasis cascade, vascular dissemination patterns, circulating tumor cell monitoring, and underlying genomic features.

topics.label: Lecture Summary and Concluding Remarks
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture by summarising how hallmarks co-occur across diverse cancer trajectories and reviewing core learning goals.
